integrity: Proof given for every positive height and all unit viewing normals. Independent verification is not claimed; the finite numerical test is supplementary, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Classification covers only the symmetric right equilateral-base triangular bipyramid family and extrema of orthogonal-shadow areas, not arbitrary bipyramids or area distributions. Historical priority is provisional; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Three-phase shadow minima and a uniquely least-anisotropic triangular bipyramid
